notes.title: "Starward" "Crossover Reprint Pool" Content Announcement
notes.notes: [p]Dear Captains:[/p][p]Based on recent feedback and suggestions from captains, we've noticed that the recent frequent crossover character content has been causing issues for you. While some of our IP crossovers aim to bring more outstanding mecha-girl designs into the game, providing captains with a fresh experience and enjoyment, this has indeed led to a series of issues. Therefore, we will be launching a "Crossover Reprint Recruitment Pool" in the future. Furthermore, we will try to stagger the release of new crossover characters and original characters.[/p][p]\[Crossover Reprint Pool Characters and Rules][/p][p]Reprint Characters (Currently Included):[/p][p]\[Hardcore Mecha - Thunderstorm Otome Type], \[Master Comic - Character 1], \[Master Comic - Character 2][/p][p]Reprint Start and End:[/p][p]Crossover Character re-engraving will begin 63 days after the character's "Linkage Recruitment UP Pool" ends in-game. Linkage character re-engraving will end approximately one calendar year after the linked character's initial release.[/p][p]Note: After the expiration date, we will attempt to renew these outstanding IPs to extend the re-engraving period.[/p][p]Re-engraving Period:[/p][p]\[Hardcore Mecha - Thunderstorm Otome Type]:[/p][p]Re-engraving Start Time: 2025/10/30[/p][p]Re-engraving End Time: Approximately one calendar year after the linked character's initial release in the pool.[/p][p]\[Da Manjiang - Character 1] \[Da Manjiang - Character 2]:[/p][p]Re-engraving Start Time: 2026/1/8[/p][p]Re-engraving End Time: Approximately one calendar year after the linked character's initial release in the pool.[/p][p]Drawing Rules:[/p][p]1. During the pool period, group leaders can recruit characters in the "Linkage Re-engraving UP Pool" using a "Special Recruitment Voucher."[/p][p]2. Guaranteed UP bonuses in the linked re-engraving pools are inherited from each other. 3. The "Linkage Re-Reprint UP Pool" will also be divided into 50% and 100% pools. The required price, probability, and guaranteed minimum draw will remain the same as the 50% and 100% pools of the current Limited UP Pool.[/p][p]4. The "Linkage Re-Reprint UP Pool" supports a fixed track feature. Team leaders can select their favorite past Linkage UP characters (within the reprint period) and set their track. After setting the track, the past Linkage UP character drawn from the "Linkage Re-Reprint UP Pool" will be the character set by the team leader (there is a risk of mismatching the permanent characters in the 50% pool, but the guaranteed minimum draw is always the fixed character).[/p][p]Note: The selected track character can be changed at any time (if multiple characters are available).[/p]

notes.title: 《星之翼》3月27日角色平衡调整
notes.notes:
各位团长好，为了让团长们有更好的游戏体验，我们决定在3月27日游戏更新后对部分角色进行平衡调整，改动如下：
=角色削弱=
【莱茵】：
1.修复【主射击】未进化时子弹初速度比进化后更快的问题，调整后，将与进化后的子弹初速度一致

【瓦尔基娅】：
1.增加【副格斗】上下瞄准角度限制

【伊娃】：
1.【主射击】的射击角度削弱：90°→60°
2.【前+主格斗】的下落速度降低20%，落地后回复能量的时间延后：15帧→17帧
3.修复【后+主格斗】的子弹可能无法正常被防御的问题，调整为仅向前方范围内散布散射射线
4.生命值增加：2510→2550

=角色增强=
【影】：
1.【副格斗+主射击】派生的爆炸飞镖弹速提升：30m/秒→40m/秒，爆炸半径提升：3m→5m
2.【副射击】速度惯性继承的时间增加：2帧→10帧，抬手时的瞄准时间增加：2帧→5帧

【绿兰】：
1.【副格斗+副格斗】在空中也能拥有移动速度

【卡捷琳娜】：
1.【副格斗】伤害增加：300→360

【埃芬】：
1.【副格斗】子弹开始移动时间提前：15帧→5帧

4.【主射击】：子弹诱导增加：30°/秒→40°/秒

notes.title: 关于举报机制判定规则
notes.notes:
近期，我们收到了部分团长关于举报后收到的扣分邮件中扣分原因不明确的反馈。为此阿猫整理了关于举报机制的主要判定规则，以便大家更清晰地了解：

扣分原因主要有四种：挂机、掉线、消极对战、频繁拒绝匹配。

1、因挂机、掉线产生的扣分是根据玩家在规定时间内是否有对局操作以及对局实际在线时长比例情况综合判定；
2、因消极对战产生的扣分是根据玩家在规定时间内的对局操作频次、总伤害输出量、对局在线时长比例情况、对局技能施放频率以及是否多次出现低频操作等综合判定。

我们深知《星之翼》的举报机制及信誉分系统自上线以来仍存在诸多待完善之处。我们将持续优化这一系统，以期为大家提供更加公平、健康的游戏环境。感谢各位团长的理解与支持！

notes.title: “Starward” Character Balance Adjustment Notice on June 6
notes.notes:
Dear Commander:
To provide a better gaming experience, we will perform a balance adjustment for some characters after the game maintenance at 12:00 on June 6. The changes are as follows:
[Character Nerfs]
Convallaria:
1. Basic performance adjustment: Total HP decreased: 3003→2723, Red lock distance decreased: 37→33 meters, Minimum dodge action time: 0.099→0.132 seconds
2. Fixed an issue where the shield HP would not be deducted when both the remote skill and the Red Flower Guard in defense mode hit simultaneously in Bloom state

Hikari:
1. Reduced the shortest attack raise time of [Forward + Main Melee]: 0.165 seconds→0.198 seconds (Melee extension part minimum duration: 0.099 seconds→0.132 seconds)

Elfin:
1. Added vertical angle limit for [Sub Melee] aiming: 60 degrees up and down

[Character Buffs]
Katerina:
1. Lock-on range increased: 31 meters→33 meters
2. Enhanced [Sub Melee]: No longer limited by ammo count, reduced action time after landing: 0.660→0.5 seconds, energy fully replenished immediately after action ends (Skill text also updated accordingly)

Roland:
1. Adjusted [Main Shoot]: SHikarily reduced inertia displacement, removed backward displacement, added interrupt route: [Any direction + Sub Melee] can interrupt [Main Shoot]
2. Enhanced [Sub Shoot]: Paralysis duration increased: 1→1.5 seconds, shooting action duration reduced: 0.66→0.396 seconds
3. Adjusted [Backward + Sub Shoot] in Liberation state: Optimized damage structure, overall damage sHikarily reduced by 10~20 points
4. Adjusted [Forward + Sub Melee]: Normal state dash speed increased: 20→25 meters/second, duration reduced: 0.825→0.66 seconds, Liberation state duration reduced: 0.825→0.660 seconds, added interrupt route: [Forward + Sub Melee] can interrupt [Forward + Sub Melee]
5. Enhanced [Left/Right + Sub Melee]: Usable with empty gauge, reduced energy consumption for lateral movement, normal speed increased: 15→20 meters/second, Liberation state speed increased: 18→24 meters/second, damage detection time reduced: 0.066→0.033 seconds, hitting target in normal state will immediately enter Liberation state, final hit in Liberation state can trigger melee derivation
6. Enhanced [Sub Melee]: Removed upward jump displacement, hitting target will immediately enter Liberation state, damage detection time reduced: 0.165→0.066 seconds, minimum melee search time reduced: 0.33→0.165 seconds
7. Enhanced Liberation state [Main Melee][Left/Right + Main Melee]: Final hit will not exit Liberation state, can trigger melee derivation, no longer forcefully knock down target. Synchronized adjustment of derivation damage structure, significant increase in melee damage in Liberation state
8. Enhanced [Main Melee + Sub Melee Derivation][Main Melee + Sub Shoot Derivation]: Strengthening time advanced by 0.033 seconds, subsequent pose action time shortened by 0.33 seconds

Zakharova:
1. Enhanced [Sub Melee]: Increased aiming angle limit: 35 degrees up and down→50 degrees up and down


Aliz:
1. Enhanced dual-form [Main Shoot]: SHikarily increased inertia
2. Adjusted [Backward + Sub Melee]: Removed camera effects
3. Enhanced [Backward + Sub Melee]: Added automatic ammo recovery effect, 1 round every 0.8 seconds
4. Enhanced [Shooting] in Cinder state: Changed shooting ammo recovery method, no recovery→recovery after depletion
5. Adjusted [Sub Melee + Sub Melee Derivation]: Optimized damage structure, overall damage sHikarily increased by 20 points
6. Adjusted [Main Melee] in Azure Flame: Third stab can also trigger melee derivation, synchronized adjustment of main melee and derivation damage structure, sHikari increase in derivation damage by 20~30 points in Cinder state

[Universal Character Adjustments]
Scorpion:
1. Fixed an issue where the second hit displacement distance was too long when the first hit of [Left/Right + Main Melee] missed

Aida:
1. Fixed an issue where [Left/Right + Main Melee] would not perform correctly on certain terrains

Griffin:
1. Fixed an issue where [Sub Shoot] bullets would be cleared after using [Main Melee + Sub Shoot] derivation in winged state

Cherub:
1. Fixed an issue where subsequent attacks might not be effective when using [Main Melee + Sub Melee] derivation

【General Adjustments】
1.【Defense】Added a 0.495-second raise time. If defense is successful within this time, both parties will retreat with the same stiffness time (excluding Xiaoling and Virtues's defense).
2.【Defense】If defense is successful after the 0.495-second raise time, a counterattack can still be made immediately, but the shield-striking party will accumulate a 10% damage reduction effect (excluding Xiaoling and Virtues's defense).
3.【Defense】No longer generates an additional 10 energy points when interrupted by dodging.
4. Now 【Defense】 can interrupt skills even in a zero-energy state.
5. Reduced the initial stiffness time of 【Defense】: 0.66 seconds → 0.33 seconds (excluding Xiaoling and Virtues's defense).
6. Weakened the minimum stiffness time after a successful 【Defense】: 0.165 seconds → 0.33 seconds.
7. Optimized the command buffering function during the initial stiffness time and the stiffness time after a successful 【Defense】.
8. Reduced the ammo recovery time of 【Defense】: 7 seconds → 2 seconds (excluding Xiaoling and Virtues's defense).

We have been listening to player feedback regarding 【Defense】, which mainly focuses on its benefits outweighing the risks, leading to a poor offensive experience.
Therefore, we have attempted a minor rework of defense, reducing the benefits of short-term defensive combat,
hoping to reduce the negative experience for the offensive side while minimizing the impact on new players' counterattack experience.
This change has a significant impact on combat, and we will monitor feedback and environmental changes in real-time to make timely balance adjustments.

9. Added a new feature for Melee Star Power Burst: After entering shield collision stagger, it will automatically exit stagger and recover, restoring 20 energy points (added to core description).
10. Increased the ammo recovery speed bonus for Shooting Star Power Burst: 100%→200% (core description updated).
11. Added a new trait for Shooting Star Power Burst: Increases shooting damage by 10% (added to core description).
12. Reduced the tracking speed of all characters' regular melee skills by 15% and tracking time by 10%.
13. Survival-type Star Energy Burst lock-on distance reduced from 13 meters to 35%

15. When sprinting away from the target, initial energy consumption will have an additional 20% cost; (current version only applies the 20% extra cost to continuous energy consumption)
16. Reduced command buffer time for [Dodge]: 0.33 seconds → 0.198 seconds (optimized to prevent double dodging when quickly pressing [Dodge] twice)
17. Trigger a [Dodge] effect when recovering in mid-air
18. New air energy penalty: After depleting energy, if staying in the air for more than 15 seconds or using 5 stop skills, all actions except Star Energy Burst will be disabled until the energy gauge is replenished

团长们可在注册当天通过7日登录活动领取三天角色月卡，激活后可在丰富的角色池中选择三名满命角色进行游玩，传送角色、史诗角色都可以自由选择哦！

[h3][b]活动三：逐星之路[/b][/h3]

活动时间：长期
通过完成教学模式、街机关卡，或使用各角色参与匹配和天梯赛，累积星数，即可领取对应逐星之路的奖励。
升级奖励包含大量特殊招募凭证、常规招募凭证、星晶、角色召唤券等，达到120级更可领取圣域守护者-基露珀。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/bda80920267cd50154b7e5d376ebce7fae90a908.png[/img]


[h3][b]活动四：新手任务-龙之试炼[/b][/h3]

活动时间：随角色创建后30天内

活动期间，完成指定任务共计可领取特殊招募凭证*30、常规招募凭证*40、蓓尔塔装扮-隐匿涂装。
若完成所有新手任务，可直接招募龙吟拳-小玲~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/1d96302fde61b4928d353092fcdb50a22f8f22c3.png[/img]


[h3][b]活动五：角色限免[/b][/h3]

活动时间：长期（每2天轮换）
角色限免功能将会提供满天赋的角色供所有团长使用，不限制玩法模式。
常驻角色有「蓓尔塔（中距离）」「迪卡莉恩（远距离）」，另外会有两名轮换角色，具体可在游戏内查看。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/03fd5a76ae3846d653e1f5c218d5048e05f4cbfe.png[/img]


[h3][b]活动六：月签到活动[/b][/h3]

活动时间：长期（每月更替）

每日登录游戏即可获得签到奖励，签到奖励包含特殊招募券、常规招募券、星晶、角色兑换券等。
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/fad09aca95a385eeb014a510841baa7347ee4b33.png[/img]



[h3][b]活动七：赛季活动[/b][/h3]

活动时间：正式开服后持续8周左右

《星之翼》第一赛季正式开启，玩家通过参与赛季活动可领取丰厚奖励；
1.赛季签到活动，玩家可在赛季页面参与赛季签到活动，每日登录签到领取常规招募券、特殊招募券、角色兑换券、赛季币；
2.参与本赛季天梯排位，到达指定段位可领取赛季段位奖励；
3.完成赛季通行证任务可领取招募券、赛季币、星晶、角色装扮等奖励，升级通行证可获得更多赛季币、招募券、角色稀有装扮等丰厚奖励；
4.使用赛季币可在赛季商店中兑换天赋髓液Ⅱ（传说角色解锁天赋材料）、角色装扮、招募券、角色兑换券等奖励。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/d31d86e61764acd2e794feede5fa56e243feb224.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/aea3abe6d2b3ce63c5fc7430283e26cd873b0534.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/021beecf86e60686f31257e50d7d642f63f34965.png[/img]



[h3][b]活动八：街机模式[/b][/h3]

活动时间：长期

街机模式是与AI进行对抗的同时，达成各种挑战目标，当前版本共计32关。获胜后可领取大量常规招募券、星晶、角色兑换券等奖励。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/1c21bc3a660259dfaa4d4cc9f14b7a97109e8278.png[/img]

[h3][b]活动九：教学模式[/b][/h3]

活动时间：长期

教学模式包含各类角色的使用技巧以及实战操作技巧，更有进阶教学可以帮助新手团长们快速成长。达成教学模式条件后，可领取大量星晶、常规招募券等奖励。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44936782/a4b102105574025cdfe3536daa5c97ebaee6f50d.png[/img]
